works.version: Bohr and Mottelson, Collective and Individual-Particle Aspects of Nuclear Structure, Dan. Mat. Fys. Medd. 27 no. 16 (1953), institutional scan
scope: PDF 1–6 front matter; 7–68 from prior source and staged reading; 69–112 staged reading of moments, level structure and early electromagnetic chapters; 113–144 staged reading of electromagnetic, beta, summary and initial appendices; 145–176 local page and scan checks of the later appendices, references and blank leaves.

PDF 116–117 Tables XXVII–XXVIII separate historical transitions, single-particle references and collective matrix estimates. PDF 128 Table XXX gives the empirical log f0t and comparative F factors. PDF 145–146 treats large-j small oscillations at stated order. PDF 155 Fig. 16 follows the coupled scattering model. PDF 162–167 App. VI and Fig. 17 identify the below-barrier approximation and trajectory integral.
works.gap: Full scope integrates distinct read ranges. Bohr and Mottelson 1953 contains model predictions and historically cited data; individual assignments and measurements have their own dates and conditions.
works.lineage: One reading credit for this archive edition. The work identifies the provenance of experimental inputs and model interpretations.
